description: This file implements a custom EventSource class for server-sent events (SSE) using React Native's networking API, including handling of event stream parsing, reconnection logic, and event dispatching within the Notesnook project.

classes.name: EventSource
classes.description: A class implementing server-sent events (SSE) using React Native's networking, with custom parsing, reconnection, and event dispatching.

methods.name: setTrackingName
methods.description: Sets a custom tracking name for the EventSource instance.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the EventSource with URL and optional configuration, sets up network listeners, and starts connection.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the SSE connection and cleans up network listeners.

methods.name: __connnect
methods.description: Establishes the network request for the SSE stream.

methods.name: __reconnect
methods.description: Handles reconnection logic with optional reason message.

methods.name: __processEventStreamChunk
methods.description: Processes incoming chunks of the event stream, handling BOM and line parsing.

methods.name: __processEventStreamLine
methods.description: Parses a line from the event stream and updates buffers accordingly.

methods.name: __dispatchBufferedEvent
methods.description: Dispatches a complete event based on buffered data.

methods.name: __didCreateRequest
methods.description: Callback for when a network request is created.

methods.name: __didReceiveResponse
methods.description: Handles network response, including redirects and MIME type validation.

methods.name: __didReceiveIncrementalData
methods.description: Handles incremental data received from network.

methods.name: __didCompleteResponse
methods.description: Handles completion of network response, including retry logic.
